dedupe_keys.name: open source multi year power generation consumption and storage data of the uc san diego microgrid

description: This dataset, described in a 2021 Journal of Renewable and Sustainable Energy article by the Center for Energy Research at the University of California San Diego, is a compiled and quality-controlled public power dataset of parts of the university's advanced campus microgrid. It covers distributed energy resources including solar power plants, electric vehicle charging, buildings, a combined heat and power gas-fired plant, and electric and thermal storage, with most series given as 15-minute averages of real and reactive power from 1 January 2015 until 29 February 2020. The authors also release Python code to fill missing data and to flag and replace potentially erroneous values. Coverage is one campus in La Jolla, California. Access: the article states the data were released publicly; the AIP article page and the microgrid.ucsd.edu site could not be opened from the cloud on 2026-09-29, so formats and the data location come from Crossref metadata and should be confirmed on a laptop pass. Licence: the article is CC BY 4.0. Caveats: a single site with campus-specific loads,, and the series stop in February 2020. It suits microgrid controller testing, load and generation forecasting, storage sizing and resilience studies, and complements the CERTS microgrid test bed data catalogued here.
